children: Sri Lankan shares closed higher on Friday, snapping a four-session losing streak, although they logged their worst weekly decline in over two months.

Trading volume on the CSE All Share index fell to 39.4 million shares from 55.4 million in the previous session.
The equity market's turnover was little changed at 1.34 billion Sri Lankan rupees ($4.05 million) from 1.33 billion rupees in the previous session, according to exchange data.
Foreign investors were net sellers, offloading stocks worth 27.3 million rupees, while domestic investors were net buyers, purchasing shares worth 1.31 billion rupees, the data showed.
